where: The ending cinematic (dawn breaks over Vesperholm)
mood: The long night ends: first light walking across every valley; the hometown lullaby finally meets the sun, radiant and tender.
core_styles: the hometown lullaby theme returned in full daylight
gentle heartbeat drums with soft brushes

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {the last dark: a hushed A minor chord, the lullaby's first notes on a lone music box, then the harmony turns and the sun breaks onto radiant C major with a harp sweep}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the hometown lullaby melody whole in radiant C major, warm lead over flowing harp arpeggios and strings, a soft heartbeat groove}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the lullaby again, now with a flute counter-melody and bell glints, strings fuller and higher, the lift reaching the sky}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a tender remembering of the long night, a gentle turn to A minor and F, the melody lower and slower, then lifting through G back toward home}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the lullaby returns radiant and complete; the last bar leads straight back into the main theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
